frontmatter.goal: Develop a comprehensive content strategy for the urban gardening Substack

content.title: Substack Content Plan
content.body: The content strategy for the urban gardening Substack will focus initially on foundational topics including container selection, soil composition, and plant recommendations for small spaces. Free tier content will cover essential information, while the future paid tier will provide in-depth guides and personalized advice. Content will be published on a weekly cadence with seasonal relevance.
